jobs.occupation: Business Performance Manager, Wound & Tissue Repair
jobs.description:
Business Performance Manager, Wound & Tissue Repair

Coloplast is on an exciting journey and the bar has been set high with the recent launch of our 5-year strategy, Impact4. The new business unit ‘Wound and Tissue Repair’ (WTR) has been formed where we are creating an innovation leader by combining Kerecis (Biologics) and Advanced Wound Dressings. The ambition is to grow the business at around a double-digit growth rate annually and improve profitability over the strategy period. To help deliver on this ambition, we are looking for a strong talent to join WTR Finance and specifically the Business Performance & Planning team in Denmark.

About the role

The Business Performance & Planning team consists of five talented people and together we are responsible for performance management of the business and key processes such as monthly performance reviews, investment cases, sales, and cost management, rolling forecast processes, annual business planning, ambition, and target dialogue with the global WTR organization.

As you start the new job, you can expect a steep learning curve as you settle into our data-based set-up and processes where you will provide high-quality financial analysis and performance insights that lay the foundation for key decision-making at senior management level.

The business unit has a global footprint with main hubs in US, Germany, Iceland, and Denmark. The role is placed in Denmark and will be working with the wider Coloplast Finance community across the world.

If you are an experienced finance professional that likes to work in a global fast paced setting with exposure to commercial business and senior decision makers, then we suggest you keep on reading!

Discover your passion, uncover your strengths

In this role, you will truly get to identify and evolve your passion and strengths within the field of finance and create tangible value for Coloplast. For the right profile, the career opportunities in the company are vast, both in Denmark and abroad, and we are committed to developing our people professionally.

You will be responsible for updating and improving our monthly performance materials and identify key insights and actions that lay the foundation for key decision-making at senior management level.

Specifically, you will:

•    Support performance management processes incl. participation in monthly business reviews

•    Become Finance business partner for selected business areas

•    Drive financial analysis to support local and global business needs

•    Update reports and datasets that support decision making

•    Work on quarterly rolling forecast (‘beyond budgeting’)

•    Provide ongoing analytical support to the commercial functions and senior leadership

•    Participate in finance projects

•    Support financial planning and drive designated finance processes

•    Ensure fit-for-purpose reporting and analysis templates for the global organization

About you

As a person, you are eager to learn and have a go-getter attitude. You have a natural skill for process, structure and systems, and understand the need for providing relevant analysis and insights to the business. Learning on the go, you thrive in a team where we divide the tasks among us to get things done. Some international travel should be expected.

Professional qualifications

We imagine you have the following qualifications:

•    Master’s degree (or equivalent) in finance, business or economics with strong results

•    Minimum 3-5 years’ of relevant experience working within finance, investment banking, accounting or an equivalent role in an international company

•    Strong analytical skills and excel at transforming data into valuable business insights

•    Strong proficiency working with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

•    Fluency in English, Danish is not required

•    Preferably experience from studies or work abroad

•    Experience with PowerBI development is a plus

Moreover, we are looking for a person who:

•    Has an ambition and the passion for making a difference for our users and business

•    Is curious and connects with people from different cultures in a genuine way

•    Thrives in a fast-paced environment of change

•    Owns their work, helps colleagues, and gets things done

•    Can live our Coloplast values and brings positivity

Interested?

Please submit your application as soon as possible. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply online through our recruitment portal. We will close the position once we have found the right candidate.

If any questions, feel free to reach out Anders Skindhøj, Head of Finance (email: dkansk@coloplast.com).

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com..

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

**Job Description

**

As Accounting Manager at Netcompany Denmark and Netcompany Banking Services, you are responsible for accounting topics such as annual reports, IFRS, tax, VAT and the audit process. You report to the Head of Finance for Denmark and Banking Services and support in leading and developing the team.

Netcompany DK and NBS are part of the wider Netcompany Group. While Group Finance defines the finance framework, standards, and processes, you are responsible for translating these into the local context and supporting the Danish business in making informed financial and strategic decisions.

You will work closely with the local Finance leadership team, Group Finance and your fellow Accounting managers across the Netcompany Group. We are ambitious in how we develop our Finance organisation and actively embrace new technology and ways of working.

**Your responsibilities will typically include:

**

• Take end-to-end responsibility for financial reporting, annual accounts, IFRS, tax and VAT, management reporting, commercial finance and KPI forecasting.

• Act as a trusted team member in Denmark and Banking Services Finance leadership team, supporting both day-to-day decision making and the achievement of long-term ambitions.

• Translate Group Finance frameworks, standards and ambitions into the local Danish context, and make sure they are implemented well across the organisation.

• Help continue the process of creating a culture focused on quality, ownership, collaboration and continuous development.

• Support the continued development and adoption of AI-enabled tools and ways of working across Finance, actively contributing to our ambition to build a more digital, automated and insight-driven finance function.

**About you:

**

• You hold a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a comparable field.

• 3–6 years of experience in accounting, audit or a similar field.

• Proven experience working with IFRS standards and financial compliance and reporting requirements.

• Strong analytical and business-related problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complicated financial tasks.

• Structured and reliable approach to delivering high-quality results with attention to detail and within deadlines.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a real interest in developing people as well as delivering results yourself.

**To succeed in this role, you:

**

• Provide the Danish and Banking Services with clear and reliable insights that support both short- and long-term decision making.

• Ensure accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting across the Danish and Banking Services organization.

• Successfully translate Group Finance Accounting standards and ambitions into effective local processes and ways of working.

• Identify opportunities to improve financial performance, processes and reporting, and turn these into tangible results.

• Successfully contribute to the transition towards our new Finance system landscape, including our bespoke AI-driven Finance application.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

We are looking for a Data Architect to define and build a modern data foundation, transforming our current data landscape into a scalable platform that drives business growth. If you want a clear mandate and thrive at the intersection of architecture & hands-on work, bridge complex business needs and robust data architecture, this is your opportunity

About the job

We are at the beginning of an ambitious data journey and as Orifarm’s new Data Architect, you will take ownership of the architectural design of Orifarm’s future central data platform & data products and ensure our data foundation & Data management practice power reliable, high-quality solutions across the organization.

Key responsibilities:

• Design and own the end-to-end architecture of Orifarm’s current & future data platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption

• Define data models and architectural patterns for core domains such as Product, Customer, Finance, and Supply Chain

• Drive the technical MDM architecture, including data modeling, matching/merging strategies, and downstream consumption

• Navigate our existing, legacy data landscape and design the roadmap to transition into a modern, scalable, and secure architecture aligned to regulatory requirements

• Drive the data and analytics roadmap, ensuring architectural alignment with enterprise goals and business objectives

• Partner directly with our Data Engineering, Data Science and BI teams to ensure your architectural designs translate into robust, scalable, and well-documented implementations

Who are you?

You are a technically strong Data Architect with +10 years’ experience who has deep experience driving the modernization of legacy data environments and designing scalable and secure architecture. You can explain complex data concepts in a clear and convincing manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key qualifications:

• Strong experience designing and implementing modern data architectures in cloud environments (ideally Azure)

• Solid hands-on understanding of data engineering patterns, including data ingestion, transformation pipelines, and orchestration

• Proven experience with data modeling for analytical and operational use cases

• Experience working with MDM concepts and solutions, with focus on architecture and implementation rather than policy

• Good understanding of data platforms, including data lakes/lakehouses, analytical databases, and semantic layers

• Ability to work closely with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions

Who are we?

You will join a specialized and ambitious Data & Analytics department consisting of four dedicated teams: Data Architecture, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Data Science.

Currently, we are transitioning toward a modern, cloud based architectural landscape. This includes designing, building, and operating a central data platform, automated data pipelines, and a robust MDM setup aimed at delivering high value data products across the business. Culturally, we are a professional, trust based organization that values transparency, shared ownership, and the strategic vision required to shape our data foundations for the future.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Orifarm has launched Fit to Scale, our strategy to grow revenue from €2 billion to more than €3 billion by 2031. We are looking for an experienced quality leader to build a simple, harmonised and scalable Quality Management System that supports our continued growth across Europe

About the job

This is an important time to join Orifarm. Our growth ambitions require a strong and scalable quality foundation. One QMS - our common Quality Management System across Orifarm - is therefore a key strategic priority.

As Head of Corporate Quality Systems, you will own Orifarm’s global QMS and lead the One QMS transformation. Working closely with Quality Heads, operational sites, sales countries, Corporate IT and business leaders, you will ensure that common quality processes are practical, effective and consistently applied across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Define the global QMS strategy and roadmap and lead the transition to One QMS

• Harmonise and simplify quality processes across functions, countries and operational sites

• Build strong partnerships with Quality Heads and local leaders to agree, implement and sustain common standards

• Govern and maintain the global QMS, including quality policies, procedures and the electronic Quality Management System

• Act as process owner for corporate quality processes and ensure continued compliance and inspection readiness

• Drive continuous improvement and digitalisation, including the appropriate use of AI to simplify quality processes

• Own the global quality KPI framework and lead the Management Review process, providing senior management with clear insight into quality performance, risks and improvement priorities

• Lead the global Quality Culture programme and promote a proactive, patient-focused quality mindset

You will report to the VP, Quality Management and lead a team of Senior QMS Specialists. The position is based in Odense, Denmark, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week on site.

Who are you?

You bring at least ten years of experience in pharmaceutical quality management or another highly regulated industry, such as biotechnology, medical devices or healthcare. You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in pharmacy, life sciences, engineering, chemistry or a related discipline.

You have extensive experience with global Quality Management Systems and a proven track record of leading quality transformation and harmonisation in a global matrix organisation. You understand relevant GxP requirements and have supported regulatory inspections and audits. Experience with electronic quality systems is essential.

You bring a strong LEAN and continuous-improvement mindset and can identify opportunities to make quality processes simpler, more effective and digitally enabled, including through the appropriate use of AI.

As a leader, you build trust, create commitment and work effectively across functions, countries and sites. You combine strategic and risk-based thinking with the ability to challenge constructively. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders and regulatory inspectors and bring the integrity, resilience and drive required to lead a significant transformation.

You are fluent in written and spoken English. Additional languages are an advantage.

Who are we?

Corporate Quality Systems is part of Quality Management within Orifarm Operations. Our team of Senior QMS Specialists works cross-functionally with Quality teams across Orifarm, Corporate IT, Regulatory Affairs, Global Safety & business leaders. English is our corporate language.

The team provides the framework for how quality systems are governed across Orifarm. Through One QMS, you and the team will help make Orifarm fit to scale while supporting our purpose of improving access to affordable, high-quality medicines across Europe.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Are you interested in working with dairy cows and becoming part of the daily life on a modern dairy farm?

We are looking for a motivated and reliable employee for a dairy farm located in Vodskov, Denmark. Previous experience is an advantage, but it is not the most important thing. What matters most is that you are motivated, interested in working with cows and willing to learn.

Your main tasks will include:

• Milking dairy cows

• Bringing cows in for milking

• Learning and following good hygiene procedures during milking

• Feeding cows and calves

• Giving milk to calves

• Observing the animals and checking for signs of illness

• Assisting with treatment when necessary

• Completing relevant registrations and records

• Other practical tasks related to the daily work on the farm

We are looking for someone who:

• Has a genuine interest in working with cows and dairy farming

• Is motivated to learn and develop their skills

• Can speak and understand English well enough to communicate confidently at work

• Enjoys a structured working day with regular routines and responsibilities

• Is dependable and flexible

• Works well with others and contributes positively to the team

• Is able to take responsibility and show initiative in daily tasks

• Approaches practical challenges with a positive and solution-oriented mindset

• Previous dairy farming or milking experience is an advantage, but not a requirement

We offer:

• A full-time position of 37 hours per week

• Working hours scheduled between 04:00 and 19:00

• Weekend work only every third weekend

• Salary based on qualifications and experience

• A workplace where you will have the opportunity to learn more about dairy farming and working with cows

Location:

Vodskov, Denmark

Start:

As soon as possible.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Job Description

Do you enjoy designing highly available network solutions where BGP failover happens seamlessly and downtime is measured in milliseconds? Are you motivated by ownership, technical excellence, and continuous development? If so, Netcompany is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help drive and evolve our data center and enterprise network infrastructure.

Responsibilities and technologies

Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will join our Network Team, which is part of the broader Infrastructure organization. We deliver secure and reliable solutions within our private cloud environments, supporting critical systems for both public and private sector customers.

You will be working with the operation, maintenance, and evolution of Netcompany’s data center and enterprise network infrastructure. You will work on complex, business-critical initiatives spanning the entire networking domain, with opportunities tailored to support your professional growth and career development.

The role offers technical ownership and direct influence on solutions delivered to public-sector and mission-critical customers. In addition, you will work with security as well as automation and DevOps principles within networking, including stabilization and continuous development—from core routing to security and WAN/edge.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Operating, troubleshooting, expanding, and designing network solutions across data center and enterprise/campus environments.

• Enhancing network security through segmentation, policy-based routing (PBR), access control, SIEM and IPS.

• Managing and optimizing Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASR routers, ACI-switching fabric and related data center technologies.

• Automation/DevOps and Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, templates, pipelines, and code reviews.

• Collaborating closely with specialists across server, storage, and security domains while helping shape the technical direction of the network platform..

About you

You are proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused. You take accountability for your work, approach solutions with a structured and analytical mindset, help establish standards and best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of both the team and the platform. In addition, you are comfortable taking the lead and approach challenges in a structured and methodical manner.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Have several years of experience in a similar networking role.

• Have a solid understanding of scripting, automation, and Infrastructure as Code principles.

• Have hands-on experience with firewalls and network security technologies, preferably Fortinet and/or Cisco combined with strong practical experience with enterprise routing/switching, and LAN/WAN environments.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. jobs.occupation: Would you like to build data platforms that make a difference across Europe?
jobs.description:
Shape the future of data in an international organization

Do you enjoy building scalable data platforms, designing robust data pipelines, and transforming complex business requirements into reliable data solutions?

At Daka and SARIA, we're strengthening our international data landscape and are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing the data platform that supports business decisions across Europe.

Working with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Power BI, you will help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across multiple countries, business units, and operational sites. This is an opportunity to join a growing data organization where you can influence both technical solutions and future architecture while working with modern cloud technologies.

The Role

As our new Data Engineer, you will join the international Data Solutions team and become a key contributor to the development of our next-generation data platform.

You will work across multiple systems, countries, and business areas, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-quality data flows that support analytics, reporting, and business operations.

This role combines data engineering, architecture, and business understanding. You'll collaborate closely with eight colleagues across Europe, with one colleague based in Hedensted. The BI-team works according to Scrum principles, with stand-ups twice a week to stay aligned, share progress, and address challenges. Just as importantly, you will join a team with an open feedback culture, where colleagues actively help and challenge each other with the shared ambition of making each other better.

The position reports to Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, based in Germany.

Your primary workplace will be our headquarters in Hedensted, Denmark, where you will also be part of our local IT organization consisting of eight colleagues. While your daily home base is Denmark, your projects, stakeholders, and impact will span across Europe.

What You'll Be Working On

You will play a central role in both maintaining and further developing our data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and developing scalable data solutions in Azure Databricks

• Building, optimizing, and maintaining modern data pipelines

• Integrating data from ERP systems, operational applications, APIs, databases and cloud platforms

• Developing and maintaining semantic models in Power BI

• Ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility across business-critical solutions

• Supporting data architecture decisions and platform improvements

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Contributing to documentation, governance, and best practices across the data landscape

Your Technical Toolbox

We expect you to bring experience within several of the following areas:

• Azure Databricks

• PySpark

• SQL

• Data modelling and semantic layers

• Power BI

• APIs and system integrations

• Cloud-based data platforms

• Data architecture and platform design

• ETL/ELT development

• Data quality and governance

You don't need to tick every box, but we expect you to have strong experience within modern data engineering and a genuine interest in building scalable data solutions.

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You take a proactive approach, ask questions, and are comfortable challenging the status quo when you see opportunities to improve the way we work.

You enjoy taking ownership and balancing deep technical work with collaboration across different parts of the business. Working in an international environment with multiple stakeholders energizes you, and you're comfortable communicating technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You bring an open-minded, curious, and constructive approach to collaboration. As a senior member of the team, you are also passionate about sharing your knowledge and supporting the development of more junior colleagues.

Additionally, we imagine that you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field

• Have several years of experience working with data engineering and data platforms

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

• Take a structured and quality-oriented approach to your work

• Thrive in environments where you can influence solutions, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to continuous improvement

Why Join Daka and SARIA?

This is not a maintenance role. You will join a business where data and digitalization are strategic priorities, and where there is a genuine ambition to strengthen the data platform across the entire organization.

In return, we offer:

• A key position in an international organization with significant growth ambitions

• Opportunity to influence architecture, tools, and future data platform development

• Modern technologies and a cloud-first data environment

• Collaboration with skilled colleagues across Denmark and Europe

• A high degree of autonomy and responsibility

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development

• Flexible working arrangements, including the option to work from home up to two days a week

• An attractive pension scheme with an 11% employer contribution

• 23 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• Lunch programme and attractive employment conditions

Beyond the professional opportunities, you'll become part of a collaborative and down-to-earth culture where people genuinely enjoy working together. From social events and staff association activities to an informal coffee break with colleagues, community is an important part of everyday life at our headquarters in Hedensted.

Interested in joining us?

We look forward to hearing from you. Please submit your CV with a motivated profile summary through the "Apply" link.

The recruitment process consists of two interviews at our headquarters in Hedensted, with Mirco joining online. The first interview focuses on your experience, motivation, and technical skills. The second includes feedback on a personality profile and cognitive assessment.

Due to scheduled holidays, we will begin conducting interviews in November. We look forward to getting to know you then.

If you have questions regarding the role, please contact Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, phone: +49 151 729 33 576.

If you have questions about the Danish team or daily work life, please contact Thorbjørn Kloster, Head of CIO Office, phone: +45 2947 1215.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As Lead IT Auditor at SimCorp, you will be responsible for leading and executing IT audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, information security systems, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role involves assessing IT infrastructure, systems, and processes to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement. The Lead / Principal IT Auditor works closely with business units and senior leadership to test whether IT risks are managed effectively, and that the organization’s technology systems support its compliance and operational objectives.

In an IT organization like SimCorp, the Lead / Principal IT Auditor promotes collaboration among business, information security, risk management, and Internal Audit. By conducting risk-based audits and identifying relevant issues, the auditor enhances IT governance, risk management, and business resilience, ensuring compliance with policies and industry standards while promoting continuous improvement and accountability

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead and execute IT audits across various business units to assess the effectiveness of internal controls and the security of IT systems and infrastructure

• Evaluate IT processes, applications, and systems for compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards, and industry best practices

• Identify and assess IT risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps, providing actionable recommendations for mitigation and improvement

• Collaborate with IT teams and business units to ensure that audit findings are addressed and corrective actions are implemented effectively

• Prepare detailed audit reports documenting findings, recommendations, and action plans, and present these reports to senior leadership

• Monitor and track the implementation of corrective actions from prior audits to assess improvements implemented by the business and issues are resolved in a timely manner

• Ensure that audits are conducted in alignment with industry standards and regulatory requirements concerning audit of IT-related risks

• Assist in developing audit plans, schedules, and priorities, ensuring audits are conducted in line with organizational objectives

• Assist in developing and refining audit methodologies, tools, and processes to improve IT audit practices

• Stay current on emerging IT risks, regulatory changes, and audit standards to ensure that audit practices remain effective and relevant

• Provide guidance and support to junior auditors, supporting their development in IT auditing and auditing standards

**TYPE OF WORK THIS ROLE ENAGES WITH

**

• Leading IT audits to evaluate IT infrastructure, security, and compliance

• Identifying vulnerabilities and recommending improvements to strengthen IT controls and mitigate risks

• Collaborating with business and IT teams to address audit findings and validate the implemented corrective actions

**What We Value

**

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Security or similar relevant field

• 7+ years of professional experience of practical IT auditing

• Strong cross-domain IT knowledge, including network technology, operating systems, Information Security, SDLC, cloud (MS Azure)

• Solid knowledge of common IT and security standards such as CSA-CCM, ITIL, COBIT, BSI IT Grundschutz, NIST, CIS-18 and ISO/IEC 27000 series

• Relevant professional certification such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or CIA preferred

• High analytical skills, methodical know-how and conceptual understanding of complex matters

• Fluent English and effective interpersonal communication abilities

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. **Do you want to lead highly skilled engineers working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning in products used across the world?

**At Dalux, we build software that makes the construction industry smarter and more efficient. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Development Manager to lead teams in our Reality Capture department working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning .

This is a role for someone who combines strong people leadership with solid technical credibility . You do not need to be hands-on in the code every day, but you do need the experience and judgment to lead specialist teams, challenge technical decisions, and help us hire outstanding talent in the field.

**The role

**As Development Manager, you will be responsible for leading and developing a group of specialists working with Computer Vision and spatial understanding of visual data across our Reality Capture products and platform, including building and scaling performance-critical systems in C++. You will work closely with technical leaders, product leaders, and other managers across Dalux Development.

This is not just a delivery role. You will help build a strong specialist environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow in their careers, and create meaningful product impact.

At Dalux, Development Managers typically contribute across four areas:

**People leadership

**You will lead and support your team members in their professional growth, motivation, and performance. You will help create clarity, direction, and engagement in a specialist environment, and you will play an active part in attracting and hiring new colleagues.

**Team and engineering enablement

**You will help your teams succeed by improving ways of working, removing obstacles, and strengthening collaboration. In a specialist department, that also means creating the right conditions for deep technical work, knowledge sharing, and high engineering quality.

**Product and cross-functional collaboration

**You will work closely with Product Management, Design, and technical leaders to ensure that our Computer Vision and Machine Learning capabilities are translated into intuitive product features that allow users to navigate, understand, and act on real-world site data. You will help balance technical possibilities, product value, quality, and long-term sustainability.

**Organizational development and change

**As Dalux continues to grow, many of our leaders contribute beyond their own teams. You may take part in or drive initiatives related to tooling, engineering processes, quality, innovation, technical maturity, or organizational development.

**What We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a leader with a background in software development and relevant experience from Computer Vision or similar domains working with visual or spatial data .

Most importantly, you have the technical understanding and leadership maturity to lead highly skilled specialists and help them perform at a high level.

**We expect that you have:

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

• Experience with development of Computer Vision systems

• Experience taking responsibility in either technical leadership , people leadership , or both

• A passion for helping other people grow and succeed

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical roles

**It is an advantage if you also have:

**

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or applied fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Robotics, Autonomous systems, or similar

• Experience leading specialist teams or senior engineers

• Experience working with spatial data, mapping, or geometry-heavy problems in a product development context

• Experience hiring technical talent in highly specialized fields

• Experience working in empowered product teams or similar collaborative product development setups

**What Success Looks Like In The Role

**In this role, you will succeed by building a strong and healthy specialist engineering environment. That means:

• Your teams are motivated, growing, and delivering high-quality work

• Collaboration across engineering, product, and design is strong

• The department is able to attract and hire great specialist talent

• Technical depth and product impact reinforce each other

• You help scale both people and practices as Dalux grows

**Why join Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We create digital tools for the construction industry, and our products are used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

We are proud to develop our products entirely in-house , and we care deeply about engineering quality, modern technology, and building strong teams. At Dalux, you will join an environment with ambitious colleagues, real product impact, and a strong belief that great software is built by empowered people working closely together.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful leadership role in a company that is growing fast, while helping shape how specialist engineering capabilities like Computer Vision and Machine Learning create value in real products.

jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as an Offshore Siting Engineer and immerse yourself in the exciting world of renewable energy! In this role, you will deliver robust site-specific assessments and optimized wind farm concepts for offshore projects during the sales and project development phases. Imagine assessing and characterizing the offshore wind climate, developing and optimizing wind farm layouts, and performing detailed Annual Energy Production assessments. Collaborating closely with diverse teams, you will provide clear recommendations and identify technical risks while contributing to innovative solutions that support our mission for a sustainable future.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Assess and characterize the offshore wind climate, including long-term wind conditions and other site-specific factors relevant to wind farm design.

• 
Develop, evaluate, and optimize offshore wind farm layouts, balancing energy yield and technical constraints.

• 
Perform detailed Annual Energy Production assessments and site suitability assessments using various calculation models and critically evaluate results.

• 
Compare and interpret results from different engineering models to provide clear recommendations to project teams and customers.

• 
Collaborate with colleagues in Technical Sales, Loads, Turbine Engineering, and Product Management to define competitive offshore wind solutions.

What You Bring

• 
A Sc. (preferably M.Sc.) in Engineering or a related field, coupled with strong business acumen.

• 
Several years of experience in the Wind Turbine industry, ideally in R&D, project management, siting, or sales.

• 
A solid understanding of the offshore environment related to siting tasks of large offshore wind farm projects.

• 
Experience with commercially used siting tools such as Windpro and Openwind, along with a flair for learning internal tools.

• 
Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, thriving in multinational environments.

About the Team

Become part of the Siting & Warranties team within the Technical Sales department, which hosts 13 different nationalities and office hubs across Europe and Asia. This team emphasizes camaraderie and teamwork, ensuring that support is always available when needed. As a Siting Engineer, you will collaborate with some of the offshore wind industry’s leading experts, working together to find innovative solutions that drive the renewable energy transition.
